lines: // Runs when a player uses the Storm Staff: lightning strikes 10 blocks ahead of the
// player's eyes, in the direction they look.
"execute as " + e.player.uuid + " at @s anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^10 run summon minecraft:lightning_bolt ~ ~ ~",

meta.notes: The script behind the Storm Staff: msm.actions.define registers the handler msm_examples:storm_staff_power, which the item's run_script action calls with the player who used it. Open it in the Script Studio to change what the item does. Scripts run only in the Fabric mod jar export, with msm_runtime; the vanilla packs and the Java project export leave them out.
